name: Chat page from the Mac
ownerWords:
(10-18 05:32Z) from perspective of developing from mac - metal-02 network seem slow like changing tabs, the metal agent using aside, ... are we doing stupid shit?

(10-18 06:21Z) just make this UX clean, snappy. it doesnt feel like it at all.

(10-18 07:48Z) another total shitshow that doesn't work is when i request something regarding mac's prime-agent daemon. try sending a chat there, see if it responds properly.
goal: From the owner's Mac, the box's chat page on :5182 feels fast and never breaks: a cold tab switch paints in 150 ms or less, a cold page load shows the chat in 1.5 s or less, a message to a Mac chat starts its reply within the model's first-token time plus one round trip, and a release shows no red banner and loses no message. This keeps goal p16 met after it closes.

metrics.label: Median cold chat tab switch from the Mac
Cold chat page load from the Mac until the chat shows
Extra wait before a Mac chat starts its reply, beyond the model's first token, in round trips
Red banners or lost messages around a chat app release in 24 h

onMiss: For each missed metric, steer its live fix job or start one with rlm.create_session, and set the fix step's duty, job and sessionId. Read the flagged list first: cold_load and tab_switch give the samples and the Mac's load, reply gives each send's split between the Mac's own turn and the wait on the way, and release_break names the release and its first break. Re-measure with `node --import tsx scripts/duties/chat-page-mac.ts` in sieun-pi components/user-history. Measure from the Mac only with headless timing over short timeout-bounded ssh mac calls, and never open, focus or move a visible window on the owner's screen (c103). Never touch live :5182 with a debugger, signals or eval (c106). A wrong check gets a fix with a test in sieun-pi (scripts/duties/chat-page-mac.ts, chat-page-mac-probe.mjs).
